evidence.title: E-Werk Mittelbaden June 19 results release: the joint venture's Lahr data centre is being built, completion planned for 2027
evidence.excerpt: E-Werk Mittelbaden, one of the two equal shareholders of the Lahr data-centre joint venture, reports that the joint venture's second data centre, in Lahr, is being built; works began in June 2025 and completion and commissioning are planned for 2027.

metadata.date_semantics: June 19 is the release's own date and dateline, and the date of the results press conference it reports. Its present-tense statement that the Lahr data centre is being built is publication-normalized to that day. It is not an inspection day or the start date. The June 2025 start it reports predates the window and is not selected. October retrieval does not refresh the observation.
metadata.authority_basis: First-party statement by Elektrizitätswerk Mittelbaden AG & Co. KG. Its own August 4, 2025 release states that it and the Q-FOX group each hold 50% of LEITWERK Rechenzentren Appenweier/Lahr GmbH, the joint venture building the Lahr data centre.
metadata.physical_status_scope: Broad under_construction for the Lahr data-centre build: the building is being built, works having started in June 2025, with completion and commissioning still planned for 2027. No finer stage (shell, MEP, fit-out), completion percentage, IT area, rack count, capacity, workload, tenant or operating model is normalized.
metadata.status_wording_note: The sentence states that the Lahr centre is being built AI-ready. Its present passive ('wird ... gebaut') is read as a current-construction statement because the same section reports the June 2025 start and a 2027 completion that is still pending. The 'AI-ready' design claim is not normalized as a workload or capability.

metadata.successor_review: EWM's press index (pages 1 and 2, captured 2026-10-09) lists the May 12 topping-out, the June 19 results release, then only unrelated July 2 and July 21 items, with no later release. LEITWERK's press list (captured 2026-10-09) shows no completion or opening item; its newest Lahr items are the June 29 trade-magazine note and a September 24 note on a trade article, illustrated with a construction-progress image. The Q-FOX event page lists further open construction-site days on November 5 and December 3, 2026, and the BADEN CLOUD page says certification is planned for the new Lahr centre from 2027. No completion, opening, cancellation or stop on or before August 20 was found. This is a bounded first-party and press-index review, not an exhaustive permit or inspection audit.
